intro: Uldum is a massive, sealed Titan research installation tucked behind colossal stone gates in the southernmost cliffs of Tanaris. Long hidden away behind ancient wards and forgotten machinery, it remains inaccessible to modern explorers.

p: Carved into the rugged southern mountain range bordering the Tanaris desert, the monumental gateway to Uldum stands silent and impassable. Built during the ordering of ancient Kalimdor, the compound served as an advanced Titan facility tied to their mysterious efforts to shape and oversee the planet's biosphere. Titanic wardens and defensive constructs once maintained the perimeter, leaving modern mortals only monumental stone carved arches and buried secrets that have defied all mundane attempts at entry.

The site's unmistakable Titan craftsmanship draws the curiosity of dwarven scholars, yet no mechanism or key has been found that might unlock the ancient complex. Legend claims that true insight into the secrets locked within requires the lost Plates of Uldum, leaving the dwarven scholars peering through the keyhole of an empire they cannot yet breach.
